108.orchestrator_note: RUNG 5 BY THE ORCHESTRATOR (2026-09-14, Playwright): www.ieice.org sits behind an AWS WAF JavaScript challenge (HTTP 202, empty body to curl) which a browser clears. The per-edition 大会実施報告 page /jpn_r/activities/taikai/general/<year>/report_<year>.html carries the table 各ソサイエティ別、形式別のセッション数ならびに講演数; its 公募セッション (open-call) block lists presentation counts by society: 一般セッション 164+33+784+273+252 = 1,506; 公募シンポジウムセッション 44; 公募ポスターセッション 15; 学生・ジュニアポスターセッション 234; 合計 1,784. The 企画セッション block above it (大会委員会企画 8, 依頼シンポジウム 29 …) counts SESSIONS of invited/planned programme and is excluded. Attendance stated on the same page: 延べ約7,600名 over four days (cumulative daily headcount, not unique delegates). Report index for every year since 2006: /jpn_r/activities/taikai/general/<year>/report.html. Cadence: IEICE runs a General Conference (spring) and a Society Conference (autumn) — this row is the General Conference alone, events/yr 1; the Society Conference is its own row.
